transcript.answer: No. Otto's spec for support-agent TMS access (specs/support-agent-tms-access/spec.md) says a tool definition must not declare a customer id, company id or account number in its input schema. FR-034 says tool definitions registered in `apps/api` must not declare a custom… (the search excerpt cuts off here). FR-031 says every tool must be registered through `apps/api/src/tools/registerT…` (also cut off). Issue 560 says the customer scope resolver determines the customer, and that schemas are validated at registration so tools can't bypass it. I didn't read the full text of FR-034 or the issue, so I can't give their exact wording.

judgements.reason: The answer correctly says no and that schemas are validated at registration, but it omits that the ban applies at any depth and to Danish spellings, and that a test walks every registered definition.
